summary: The InstantiateInline API lets users instantiate Dataproc workflow templates inline through the API.
extended_definition: The InstantiateInline API lets users instantiate Dataproc workflow templates inline through the API.

supporting_pages.title: "Overview of Managed Service for Apache Spark Workflow Templates \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: Inline Workflows can be instantiated inline using the gcloud command with workflow template YAML files or by calling the Managed Service for Apache Spark InstantiateInline API (see Using inline Dataproc workflows ).
Workflow Templates use a per-template workflowTemplates.instantiate permission, and do not depend on cluster or job permissions.

Workflow Templates replace the steps involved in a typical flow, which include: creating the cluster submitting jobs polling deleting the cluster Workflow Templates use a single token to track progress from cluster creation to deletion, and automate error handling and recovery.
